# Karolis Tamosiunas

> Founder and full-stack engineer in Phoenix, Arizona. Builds custom software, AI agents, and automation for businesses that run on manual work, including his own storage business. Works with clients remotely.

## What he builds

- Business management software: dashboards, customer management, leases, inventory, reporting
- Customer-facing systems: online booking, self-service portals, payments, automated agreements
- Financial automation: QuickBooks sync, automated invoicing, payment tracking, custom reports
- AI agents and workflows: document parsing, data extraction, automated follow-ups

## How to start

- The Automation Blueprint: $999, fixed scope, delivered in one week. A map of how work flows through the business, automation opportunities ranked with ROI math, a build-or-buy recommendation for each, and a fixed quote for anything worth building. The $999 is credited toward the build.
